g.text: Image decisions · 15 hosted + 2 local routes · 200 questions each
Local runs: October 25, 2026, Ollaya 0.17.0; cold loading/warmups excluded; hardware/electricity unmeasured.
The older RTX 2060 6 GB was deliberately chosen as an accessible setup. Hosted measurements retain earlier dates and costs.
Local PNGs preserve reviewed decoded RGB pixels; older hosted inputs keep original PNG/JPEG bytes. Route timings are not controlled hardware comparisons.
Speed: green ≤500 ms, yellow ≤1 s, orange ≤2 s. Cost/1,000: green ≤$0.05, yellow ≤$0.15, orange ≤$0.50, red above. ~ tariff calculation; * missing charges.
